STEP 7 - Energy: Raw cauliflower ≈ 25 kcal/100 g. 160 g x 25 kcal/100 g ≈ 40 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A modest pile of florets on a large plate, about 160 g and 40 kcal, is plausible for what is visible. Scattered florets and gaps are accounted for by the bulk density.
